BUSINESS ASSOCIATE AGREEMENT (BAA)

This Business Associate Agreement is entered into between Covered Entity and
Business Associate pursuant to the Health Insurance Portability and
Accountability Act and the HITECH Act.

The Business Associate shall implement administrative safeguards, physical
safeguards, and technical safeguards reasonably designed to protect the
confidentiality, integrity, and availability of protected health information
(PHI) that it creates, receives, maintains, or transmits on behalf of the
Covered Entity.

Administrative safeguards include a documented security management process,
workforce security training, and periodic risk analysis.

This Agreement is effective through December 31, 2027 and shall be reviewed
annually.
